intent: Tests: Python 3.9-compatible hook writer in test_precommit_override
notes: `tests/test_precommit_override.py`: the fixture's `_write_hook()` used `Path.write_text(newline="\n")`, which exists only on Python 3.10+. Both py3.9 CI lanes errored in setup (52 errors, source-ci run 36509957769). It now uses `open(..., newline="\n")`, keeping LF hook scripts for sh on Windows. A static 3.9-grammar parse of all 21 files changed since 2.17.0 found no other incompatibility. No product code changed.
`scripts-precommit.md`: new Testing Notes — the override tests generate real `sh` git hooks (must be LF, written with `open(..., newline=)`), and test code must run on Python 3.9, the CI floor.
